thread:
alyssa: Hey folks — opened a docs PR to update the model catalog entry for Vega13B and Nebula3B. Includes: supported variants, updated sequence limits, new benchmark numbers, and a short compatibility note for quantized variants. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812

matt: Thanks — skimmed. main question: where did the new 3.5x throughput number come from?

alyssa: Good q. Bench ran on dedicated A100s with our latest kernel selection + batch window tweaks. Raw command in the PR:```bash
python bench/run.py --model=vega13b --variant=nvq4 --seq=1024 --bs=8 --profile=throughput
```
Results attached as CSV in the PR.

kiran: Can we add a short note about the fallback behavior for nvq4 on CPU edge? Had one customer confusion last week. Suggest adding a tiny paragraph under "compatibility".

alyssa: yep — added a 2-sentence note in the draft. It says: "If nvq4 is unavailable on the target runtime, requests will fallback to the fp16 variant; latency will increase ~2x and cost may rise. See runtime fallback docs link."

lucy: Also flagged that the SDK snippet in the card still uses the old sync client. Need a small code update for SDKv4 async example.

alyssa: Good catch. Drafted SDK v4 snippet:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)
resp = await client.generate(model="vega13b-nvq4", input="Summarize...")
print(resp.text)
```
I'll paste into the PR.

ben: Quick nit: sequence limit table uses "max_len" header; our canonical is "max_sequence_length". Please normalize for searchability.

alyssa: Done. Reworded header + updated links.

matt: Two small asks before LGTM: 1) add a one-line callout about memory footprint for 2048 vs 4096 seq on the quantized variant; 2) add a link to the runtime compatibility matrix (broken link in current draft).

alyssa: #1 added (approx 12GB -> 20GB for 4096 on nvq4 per node). #2 — fixed the link; it was pointing to stale slug.

kiran: I'll do a semi-quick pass for wording and push any grammar nits.

deploy-bot: Build check started for PR #812 — docs lint, linkcheck, example-snippet tests.

ben: One more: bench CSV contains an outlier for bs=1, seq=4096 that looks like a measurement hiccup. Can you re-run that point or mark it as noisy?

alyssa: re-ran that case and updated CSV. It was a warmup issue, new run looks consistent. Updated a footnote in the benchmarks section.

matt: OK from infra side. If docs team signs off on wording and SDK snippet, we can merge after CI passes.

lucy: I can take final sign-off. Will review in next 30m.

alyssa: thanks all — ping me if you want additional numbers or a brief blurb for the migration guide (for customers moving from fp16->nvq4).

lucy: LGTM with one tiny wording tweak. Approving now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #812 — merging in 10s.

alyssa: merged — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short release note and a ticket to add an automated snippet linter for SDK v4 examples.

matt: nice work!

ben: thanks :party:
